en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a large historic building on a hill with a tiled roof and many windows, identified as Schloss Klippenstein. Below it are stone walls, an arched gate, smaller half-timbered houses, and a narrow street running alongside the fortification. Trees and foliage surround parts of the structure, giving it a picturesque medieval-town appearance. The caption at the top reads "Radeberg — Schloss Klippenstein" in a serif script.
